full_command: uv run --with numpy --with scipy --with cma --with jax python -m experiments.heilbronn.bench
pass_criteria: A candidate must pass coordinate validation and beat the best strong reproducible baseline by at least 5% mean objective value across fixed seeds.
candidate_command: uv run --with numpy --with scipy --with cma python -m experiments.heilbronn.bench --ns 10,11,12 --seeds 2 --n-steps 20000 --n-starts 4 --methods SA-uniform,CMA-ES --candidate {candidate} --json
search_command: uv run --with numpy --with scipy --with cma python -m experiments.heilbronn.bench --ns 13,15 --seeds 2 --seed0 1 --n-steps 10000 --n-starts 4 --methods CMA-ES --candidate {candidate} --json
confirm_command: uv run --with numpy --with scipy --with cma python -m experiments.heilbronn.bench --ns 13,15 --seeds 1 --seed0 101 --n-steps 20000 --n-starts 4 --methods CMA-ES --candidate {candidate} --json
candidate_interface: Write a Python module exposing exactly: solve(n: int, seed: int, budget: int) -> an (n, 2) array-like of point coordinates in the closed unit square [0,1]^2. The objective is the Heilbronn triangle problem: MAXIMIZE the area of the smallest triangle formed by any 3 of the n points. The harness recomputes the area from your returned coordinates (experiments.heilbronn.evaluator.min_triangle_area); wrong shape, out-of-bounds, or non-finite output poisons the trial. `budget` is the total function-evaluation budget; the comparison baseline (CMA-ES) gets the same budget. numpy and scipy are available; importing experiments.heilbronn.baselines (sa_uniform, sa_halton, scipy_basinhopping), baselines_cmaes, or the evaluator to build on them is allowed and encouraged. Deterministic in `seed`. ALSO expose solve_ablated(n, seed, budget) with your key mechanism disabled. RECORD TARGETS (best-known min-triangle areas, unit square; beating one with valid coordinates is a new mathematical record): n=11: 0.03703704 (1/27, Goldberg 1972 — unimproved for 54 years), n=13: 0.0270 (Karpov 2011), n=15: 0.0211 (Karpov 2011). Your best validated area per n is automatically compared against the cached record table.
